description: Change an existing image asset with a written instruction (recolour it, add a hat, fix a detail); the edit is added to that asset as a new frame and the original stays. For a new picture use generate_image; for a pixel version at another size use resize_sprite. 5 credits on every call (each call makes and bills another edit; refunded if it fails); a slow run returns a job for check_generation. Returns the new frame's id and image key, which referenceFile on rotate_sprite, animate_sprite or another edit_image call takes.

frameId.description: Optional: the frame the new frames hang under in the editor (usually the frame referenceFile came from).

id.description: Asset ID (from list_assets / get_asset or a previous result)

images.description: Optional extra reference images: image keys from any of your assets (get_asset lists them), or their cdn.voidless.dev URLs. Other links are refused: upload the picture first

model.description: The edit model, as the app's Edits setting offers (same price, 5 credits): p-image (default, the app's editor), gpt-image-2.5 or flux2-klein. Only when the user names one

prompt.description: The change to make, as one instruction, e.g. 'make the cloak dark red' or 'give him a straw hat'. Unmentioned parts are kept

referenceFile.description: Work from one image instead of the asset's base: an image key from any of your assets (as get_asset lists it), or its cdn.voidless.dev URL. Empty = the asset's current base image.

remove_bg.description: Remove the background from the result, as the app's editor does. Set false for artwork or a scene that should keep its background

name: edit_image
